study type: Experimental animal study (comparison of intervention methods)
exposure: Intrathecal injection of recombinant human sulfamidase (rhSGSH)
outcome: Reductions in primary substrate levels in brain
Reductions in secondary substrate levels in brain
Reductions in microgliosis in superficial cerebral cortex
Amelioration of microgliosis in deep cerebral cortex
Prevention of glutamic acid decarboxylase-positive axonal spheroids
cohort: Dogs with mucopolysaccharidosis type IIIA (MPS IIIA).
finding: Treatment with recombinant human sulfamidase (rhSGSH) via intrathecal, intra-cisternal, or ventricular routes significantly reduced primary/secondary substrate accumulation and secondary pathology in the MPS IIIA dog brain, with ventricular injection showing superior amelioration in deep cerebral cortex compared to other routes.
